children: Brian Mandell, an officer serving as Executive Vice President, reported a sale of Phillips 66 common stock. The shares were sold on 2026-09-16 at a weighted average price of $265.059 per share. The total reported sale amount was $6,202,380. After the transaction, Mandell directly beneficially owned 61,594 shares, which include 22,182 restricted stock units that settle one-for-one for common stock.
